title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for W'/W as 1/3.

title: Work Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state the work equations for both monatomic and diatomic gases.

title: Temperature Values
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and use the temperatures T1 and T2 in their calculations.

title: Adiabatic Relations
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the adiabatic equations correctly to relate volumes and temperatures.

title: Logarithm Application
description: Optional Criteria: The student may demonstrate understanding by correctly applying logarithmic properties in the ratio of works.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency in units throughout their calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the gas constant R.

title: Volume Values
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that the volume values V1 and V2 are correctly identified and used.
